items.question: How do vowels and consonants differ in their ontological independence within the phoneme system?
premises: Vowels are independent among the letters.
The phoneme system distinguishes independent and dependent sounds.
items.inference: Vowels possess independent status while consonants depend on vowels for manifestation.
uncertainties: Fused token segmentation is editorial; exact sandhi boundaries uncertain.
items.plain_english: Among those letters, the vowels are independent; by them the consonant is manifested.
